opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations working with disability, for projects helping people live more independently, particularly training, employment and supported housing, especially supporting young people transitioning from children's to adults' services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated, for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open and accessible to the public, listed at Grade I/II*/A/B etc. or a Scheduled Monument.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and families, for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK caring for nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to museums and galleries to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK focused on professional performance, with the performing arts constituting the vast majority of their activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to performing arts organisations to improve their training and education facilities, generally for building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally for related specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent), local authorities or universities in the UK displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (for equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (for new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results, an Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI overall outcome of 'Good' or above, and demonstrable excellence or significant progress towards excellence.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application process. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects at secondary level that help pupils develop skills for employment or independent living after school or college.
